quote:
the planet who gets the next greatest number 
of degrees becomes the Amatyakaraka or the sub-lord.

consequent.text: Atmakaraka (soul indicator): the planet with the highest degree-in-sign; reflects the whole chart's strength. Natural AK is the Sun.

quote:
The planet having the highest longitude in a sign becomes 
the Atmakaraka. The strength or weakness of the Atma- 
karaka seems to reflect the general strength or weakness 
of the entire horoscope

consequent.text: Matrukaraka (mother): the planet with the next-highest degrees; natural MK is the Moon.

quote:
The lord of mother is the planet that gets the next 
highest number of degrees in a sign. Chandra or the 
Moon is however the natural karaka of mother.

consequent.text: Jaimini has 7 chara (movable) karakas — Atma, Amatya, Bhratru, Matru, Putra, Gnathi, Dara — assigned by degree-in-sign, any planet able to acquire any karakatwa.

quote:
There are 7 main karakas in Jaimini, viz., 
(1) Atma, (2) Amatya, (3) Bhratru, (4) Matru, (5) Putra, 
(6) Gnathi and (7) Dara.
